content.short: SpinCity Tycoon is a city-building strategy game on TON where players stake NFTs to earn rewards.
content.description: SpinCity Tycoon is a sophisticated city-building and strategy game built on the TON blockchain. It allows players to develop their digital metropolises by strategically constructing and managing various urban elements. A unique feature of the game is the ability to stake 'Slot NFTs' to generate yield and earn $SPINFUN tokens, merging traditional tycoon simulation with innovative DeFi mechanics. SpinCity Tycoon provides a deep and visually engaging experience for players who enjoy long-term strategy and the benefits of digital asset management on TON.
content.meta: Build your urban empire in SpinCity Tycoon on TON. Staking and strategy combined on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
